results.content: Pinata is a data management tool that helps you to use IPFS or InterPlanetary File System in a hassle-free manner. The simple and clean IPFS API and toolkit of the app simplifies immutable data that remains constant once the coding is done.

results.title: Introduction - Pinata Docs
results.content: Pinata's x402 enables you to monetize your private IPFS files by receiving USDC payments directly to your wallet. You set the price, you receive the payment.
